match.timeMine: You propose {{time}}. Waiting for {{name}}. Without agreement, the match is at {{default}}.
match.timeNone: Propose a time. Without agreement, the match is at {{default}}.
match.ruleLate: After {{minutes}} minutes' absence at the set time, it's a loss by forfeit.
match.ruleFine: A forfeit costs a {{amount}} cowrie fine, paid into the pot.
match.ruleSecond: {{name}} forfeited last matchday: missing again makes 2 in a row. They're excluded and you win 3 pts.

rule.imposed: League rule: the board is set by the organiser.
rule.home: League rule: the home player picks the board.
rule.rotation: League rule: one board per matchday, set by the schedule.
rule.agreement: League rule: both propose; without agreement, the default board.

choice.ruleHomeSecond: League rule: the home player picks the board. For the first leg, {{name}} picked {{board}}. For the second leg, it's your turn.
choice.ruleHomeSecondThem: League rule: the home player picks the board. For the first leg, you picked {{board}}. For the second leg, it's {{name}}'s turn.
choice.edgeMe: Your edge: about {{percent}}% chance for you
choice.default: Without a choice in time, the match is played on the default board ({{board}}). {{name}} sees your choice as soon as you confirm it.
choice.sent: Choice sent: {{board}}. If both legs end level, a 5-minute decider on the first-leg board ({{first}}).
choice.notYours: Board {{who}}: you'll see it here as soon as it's set.

exclusion.title: {{name}} is excluded
exclusion.whyConsecutive_one: 2 forfeits in a row ({{rounds}}). The league goes on with {{count}} player.
exclusion.whyConsecutive_other: 2 forfeits in a row ({{rounds}}). The league goes on with {{count}} players.
exclusion.whyTotal_one: 3 forfeits in all ({{rounds}}). The league goes on with {{count}} player.
exclusion.whyTotal_other: 3 forfeits in all ({{rounds}}). The league goes on with {{count}} players.
exclusion.annulled: {{name}} played {{played}} of {{total}} matches, less than half: all their results are cancelled.
exclusion.kept: {{name}} played {{played}} of {{total}} matches, at least half: their results stand, their remaining matches are lost 1–0.
exclusion.calendarBye: The fixture table doesn't change. Where {{name}} was due to play, their opponent rests.
exclusion.calendarRepacked: The schedule is tightened: the remaining matchdays are redrawn without {{name}}.
exclusion.mineChanged: Your schedule changes: check your next matches.
exclusion.refund: Given back to {{name}} (the rest of their entry, {{rest}}, stays in the pot)
exclusion.shareNote_one: The pot is shared among {{count}} player: everyone's finishing share goes up. The split is recalculated automatically.
exclusion.shareNote_other: The pot is shared among {{count}} players: everyone's finishing share goes up. The split is recalculated automatically.
exclusion.none: Nobody is excluded from this league.
